items.subtitle: Operational continuity and preservation of industrial assets.
items.description: Comprehensive preventive and corrective maintenance programs for rotating and static mechanical equipment, non-destructive testing (NDT), and planned plant shutdowns under high international standards to avoid production losses.

specifications.detail: Repair of rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines) and static equipment (pipelines, pressure vessels).

specifications.detail: Cleaning services, non-destructive testing (NDT), inspection, and replacement of production and transfer lines.

specifications.label: Fleet Autonomy
specifications.detail: Guarantee of 24/7 availability of our assets through internal preventive and corrective maintenance programs.

specifications.label: Stimulation and Flow
specifications.detail: Comprehensive solutions to improve hydrocarbon flow and recondition inactive wells.

specifications.label: Equipment Replacement
specifications.detail: Replacement of essential equipment, including variable frequency drives and progressive cavity pumps.

specifications.label: Logistical Support
specifications.detail: Supply of heavy equipment for transversal logistical activities for well operations.

items.title: SANITATION AND <gold>RACDA</gold>
items.subtitle: Comprehensive ecological management of hazardous waste.
items.description: Authorized service for the transport and final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste, backed by MINEC RACDA certification. Technical spill cleanup and implementation of authorized bioremediation processes.

specifications.label: Waste Management
specifications.detail: Collection, transport, and final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste, drilling cuttings, and fluids.

specifications.label: Sanitation and Remediation
specifications.detail: Cleanup of hydrocarbon spills, and bioremediation of affected soils and water bodies.

specifications.detail: Supply of cranes (mobile and crawler), excavators, heavy forklifts, and chain tractors.
